sources.text: South Tyrol (Toblach); pasteurised whole cow's milk. ONAF: about 6 weeks at 12-13 C, wheels washed with salt water, can age to ~5 months; Guffanti gives 60 days minimum. Not the longer-aged Hochpustertaler

facts.v: Melts like mozzarella; small flaky texture; sweet flavour
Made to use surplus milk at the Dobbiaco dairy (founded 1883); listed as a traditional food product (PAT) at the request of the Province of Bolzano
